excluded_by_design.aggTrades_and_trades: Not required for a 30-minute-to-8-hour non-latency hypothesis; much larger event-level data.
excluded_by_design.bookTicker: Available only from 2023-05 and roughly tens of MB per day; too large and unnecessary for the proposed horizon.
excluded_by_design.bookDepth: Public percentage-depth snapshots start in 2023; useful only for a separate depth hypothesis and not full order-event history.
excluded_by_design.liquidations: No BTCUSDT liquidationSnapshot keys found in the official archive prefix.

interpretation_limits: BTCUSDT perpetual and spot are Binance-only, not consolidated crypto markets.
Top-trader and long/short ratios are exchange-defined aggregates, not trader-level positions.
Funding-rate rows record settlement rates; signal availability must be lagged until calc_time.
Open interest is a snapshot and does not identify whether new exposure is long or short.
Downloading data does not authorize inspecting locked future-return partitions for hypothesis tuning.
